common.disclaimer: The figures shown here are an estimate from Lumio, not a tax filing: always check with an accountant before using them in a tax return.

config.intro: Your tax residence determines which regulation (jurisdiction) applies to your investments. Set it once: it stays valid until you change it, no need to redeclare it every year. If you lived under different jurisdictions in the past, add more than one row with the year each period started (e.g. 2010 Italy, 2015 Switzerland, 2020 Italy) — Lumio reconstructs the intervals for you. Italy has no split-year rule: you're a resident for the whole calendar year, that's why this is chosen per year, never for a specific date.

empty.title: No tax residence declared
empty.description: Without a declared residence, Lumio defaults to Italian rules — declare it to make that explicit.

rules.intro: The tax regulation in force on the selected date — the same data structure that drives the calculations, never a separate write-up.
rules.treatmentsTitle: Treatment by class and event type
rules.notCodified: Not codified — excluded from the calculation
rules.offsetDescription: A loss in this category can offset a gain in this other one:
rules.offsetNone: No offsettable pair under this ruleset.
rules.carryForwardYears: Unoffset losses can be carried forward for {{years}} years from formation.
rules.conversionsDescription: Losses formed before the rate change are usable today at a reduced value, fixed by law:

regimeSection.title: Tax regime
regimeSection.description: A brokerage account can go through more than one regime over time (e.g. an account born declarative that became administered after an IBAN change) — each period applies from its date until the next one.
regimeSection.duplicateError: A period with this start date already exists.
regimeSection.addError: Could not add the regime period.

tab.title: Taxes
tab.seeFull: Go to the full loss pocket

card.title: Tax classification
card.notCodifiedBadge: Not codified — excluded from the calculation
card.dialogDescription: Override the automatically derived class only if you know it's wrong (e.g. an ETC mistaken for a harmonized ETF).

page.title: Loss pocket
page.intro: Losses not yet offset, by perimeter. No total ever sums administered and declarative: they're two separate buckets by law.

noRegime.title: No regime set
noRegime.description: The loss pocket doesn't mean anything without knowing what regime your brokerage account is under — open the account, then Edit, and set the tax regime at the bottom of the page.

noData.title: No losses right now
noData.description: Lumio automatically computes losses from your recorded buys/sells, but none show up — if you have losses from before you started using Lumio (or that Lumio can't reconstruct), add them as an opening balance.

lossPocket.coverageNotice_one: {{count}} sale excluded from the calculation (uncodified asset or account with no regime on that date) — the total is partial.
lossPocket.coverageNotice_other: {{count}} sales excluded from the calculation (uncodified asset or account with no regime on that date) — the total is partial.

openingDialog.title: New opening balance
openingDialog.perimeterHint: Sources disagree on what happens to losses when moving between regimes: you choose the correct perimeter, Lumio won't guess it for you.
openingDialog.error: Could not save the opening balance.

realizedEventsPage.title: Realized events
realizedEventsPage.intro: Every sale that closes (even partially) a lot — including events excluded from the calculation, with a reason. An audit view, not a summary: shows the raw calculated figure, never a "ready to file" view.

empty.title: No realized events
empty.description: No sale has closed a lot yet — or none match the chosen filters.

eventOverride.title: Correct realized event
eventOverride.description: Override the calculated gain/loss only if you know it's wrong (e.g. a historical cost basis from before you used Lumio), or manually exclude it from the calculation.
eventOverride.amountLabel: Corrected gain/loss (empty = use the calculated value)
eventOverride.excludeLabel: Exclude this event from the calculation
